function.description: Get cross-chain bridge quote with routes, pricing, ETA, and each route's DEADLINE (expiresAtUnixSeconds plus expiresInSeconds remaining). khalani.bridge hard-fails with deadline_expired past that deadline, so check the remaining window before acting and re-quote if it has run out. Resolve fromToken/toToken addresses via khalani.tokens.search first.
function.name: khalani__bridge_quote_get

amountRaw.description: Amount to bridge, in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Raw base units as an integer string (not human decimals) — read the token's decimals from `TokenFind` first.

filler.description: Restrict quotes to a specific filler.
